footer_credit: Created by xkain
security_text: Privacy & security: this page runs in your browser, nothing is stored.
installer_footer_text: The firmware comes from the project's GitHub releases and goes straight to your device.
index_description: Use the online tools to set up and run your system with ease.
geo_description: Get your home's GPS coordinates to automate your devices according to the sun's course.
option_1_desc: Use your browser's geolocation to retrieve your current position.
option_2_desc: Enter the country and the name of your city to set your position.
option_2_hint: Pick a suggestion from the list to set your position.
err_gps_unsupported: Geolocation is not supported by your browser.
err_no_results: No results. Try adding the country, or a different spelling.
err_search_failed: Search failed (this step needs an internet connection).
installer_description: Install ESPSomfy-RTS in just a few clicks, upload a .bin file, or view serial logs directly from your browser.
installer_connect_body: Connect your device to a USB port on your computer, click the Connect button, then select the port in the window that your browser will open. Everything happens here: no data leaves your computer and the firmware is transferred directly without using a server.
installer_connected_body: Connection established. Choose an online version to install, upload a local file, or view serial logs.
installer_compat_warning: Browser installation requires a Web Serial capable browser (Chrome, Edge or Opera) on a computer, with this page loaded over HTTPS.
installer_noport_body: Four common causes, in order of frequency: a charge-only USB cable (no data wires); a missing USB-to-serial driver (CP2102 or CH340); an unsupported browser (use Chrome, Edge, or Brave); or the device was plugged in after opening the window. Try another cable, check the driver and browser, then try again.
installer_thirdparty: Flashing is powered by ESP Web Tools and esptool-js, licensed under Apache-2.0.
installer_box_eth_boot_notice: For this model: hold down the push button under the box before clicking "Install". Release it once erasing is done and firmware writing has started. Once installation is complete, unplug and replug the box so it exits flashing mode.
installer_prerelease_notice: This is a pre-release: it is published to be tried out, not for everyday use. It may carry faults already fixed elsewhere. Prefer the latest stable version, unless you specifically mean to test this one.
installer_manual_v3_intro: Only complete images will do (bootloader, partition table, firmware and interface): those files carry the word "factory". Hand over the .zip as it is, no need to extract it.
installer_manual_v3_leg1: The image version, for example: v3.0.0.
installer_manual_v3_leg2: The board model: esp32, esp32wrover, esp32c3, esp32s2 or esp32s3.
installer_manual_v3_leg3: BOX_wifi or BOX_eth: for owners of one of my cases (FR) only. This part is absent from images built for generic boards.
installer_manual_v2_intro: Only complete images will do (bootloader, partition table, firmware and interface): those files carry the word "onboard". Hand over the .zip as it is, no need to extract it.
installer_manual_v2_leg1: The board model: esp32, esp32wrover, esp32c3, esp32s2 or esp32s3.
installer_manual_v2_leg2: The flash size, 4mb or 8mb. Present on ESP32-S3 images only, absent everywhere else.
installer_manual_chip_unknown: The board model cannot be deduced from this file name. Keep the original name of the downloaded image: it is what tells which chip the image is meant for.
installer_manual_zip_error: Archive unreadable, or compressed in an unsupported format.
installer_flash_state_finished_body: Unplug and replug your device, or just wait: it restarts automatically.
installer_flash_error_not_supported: This firmware doesn't support the detected chip ({chip}).
installer_flash_error_init: Couldn't connect to the device. Try again, or hold the BOOT button while clicking "Install".
installer_flash_error_image: Could not download the image for this version.
installer_logs_open_error: Could not open the serial port: {message}
